questions.question: Describe an end-to-end ETL pipeline you built using SSIS, including the source systems, transformation logic, incremental-load approach, error handling, and how you monitored production runs.

In your work on supply-chain and marketing data marts, how did you design fact and dimension tables? Please explain the grain, surrogate-key strategy, handling of slowly changing dimensions, and any trade-offs you made.
You have experience with SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, and Azure storage. How would you approach migrating or rebuilding an existing SQL Server/SSIS warehouse pipeline in Snowflake using dbt?

What ETL versus ELT considerations would guide your design for loading operational-system data into Snowflake, particularly when transformations include business rules, data quality checks, and history loading?

Describe a difficult SQL performance issue you diagnosed for an ETL process, SSRS report, or data warehouse query. How did you identify the bottleneck, what changes did you make, and how did you validate the improvement?

This role uses Airflow and Python for orchestration and pipeline development. How would you design an Airflow DAG for a daily pipeline with source extraction, staging, dbt transformations, data-quality validation, dependencies, retries, alerting, and backfill support?

You developed standard ETL integrations for Community-Loan-Location data and applied business rules. How did you document source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, assumptions, and data-quality expectations so that business and technical stakeholders could review them?

Tell us about your experience leading data warehouse or BI delivery work. How did you divide work among team members, review ETL or SQL changes, address technical disagreements, and support less-experienced engineers?
When a stakeholder requests a new marketing or customer-performance metric, what process would you use to turn that request into a governed warehouse model and reliable reporting dataset?

You have supported DevOps repositories and code pipelines for ETL jobs. What Git workflow, deployment controls, testing practices, and rollback approach would you establish for production data-pipeline changes in a remote engineering team?
